subject: Security vetting session & calendaring for StormByte evaluation
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stormbyte.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@stormbyte.com>
Cc: procurement@stormbyte.com, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security vetting session & calendaring for StormByte evaluation

Hi Alex / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to keep the momentum. Our next milestone to unblock procurement/technical sign-off is a short security vetting session between your security/infra team and our security & SE folks. Goal: 45 minutes to cover architecture, data flows, retention, and any compliance questions.

Proposed windows next week (PT):
- Tue 9/23 10:00–10:45
- Tue 9/23 14:00–14:45
- Wed 9/24 09:00–09:45

Please let me know which of those works for your team or share a couple alternatives. Ive attached our short pre-read checklist (redwood-sec-ask.pdf) — would appreciate if Samir or your security lead can scan it before the call.

Attendees from our side: me (AE), Elliot Price (Solutions Engineer), Marcus Lin (Security Lead). If procurement wants to join briefly for contract timing, happy to include them.

Next steps: confirm time, Ill send a calendar invite and the brief.

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0138 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stormbyte.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stormbyte.com>, procurement@stormbyte.com
Date: 2025-09-18T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security vetting session & calendaring for StormByte evaluation

Hi Tessa — thanks, this looks good. Samir (cc) is our security lead; hes available Tue 9/23 14:00 PT and Wed 9/24 09:00 PT. Procurement can join if the slot is Tue afternoon.

A few quick asks from our side:
- Can we get a 1-page architecture diagram or top-level data-flow ahead of time?
- Do you have a short SOC2 summary we can share with legal?

If Tue 9/23 14:00 works for your folks, mark us tentative and well confirm with procurement.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Sr. Platform Eng Manager, StormByte
alex.johnson@stormbyte.com

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security vetting session & calendaring for StormByte evaluation

Tessa / Marcus —

I can take the 14:00 PT slot on Tue 9/23. Marcus, can you confirm if youre ok for Tue 9/23 14:00 or Wed morning? Ill prep a concise infra diagram (1 slide) and bring the runtime/kv-cache topics Alexs team tended to ask about.

Also, do we want to include a short "ask list" for Samirs review (e.g., retention windows, encryption-at-rest keys, PCI/PHI handling)? I can throw that into the calendar invite.

—Elliot
Elliot Price | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-19T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security vetting session & calendaring for StormByte evaluation

Im good for Tue 9/23 14:00 PT. Agenda suggestion (45m):
- 5m: intros + objectives (Tessa)
- 10m: architecture & data flow (Elliot)
- 15m: security controls & compliance posture (me)
- 10m: Q&A / outstanding asks (Samir / procurement)
- 5m: next steps / procurement align

Attached: redwood-sec-brief.pdf (short brief), SOC2-summary.pdf.

Elliot — please add the 1-slide infra diagram and the brief "ask list" you mentioned. Tessa: Ill be light on policy detail unless they ask; focus on concrete controls and where we can provide artifacts.

Marcus Lin
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
